final: WITH invoice_averages AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(product_quantity) AS average_quantity, AVG(1.0 * (derived_product_cost - derived_total_cost) / NULLIF(derived_total_cost, 0)) AS cost_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_quantity) AS overall_average_quantity FROM invoice_averages) SELECT i.invoice_number, i.average_quantity, i.cost_ratio, i.average_quantity - o.overall_average_quantity AS quantity_difference FROM invoice_averages AS i CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE i.average_quantity > o.overall_average_quantity ORDER BY quantity_difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
